title: Maratón de Buenos Aires 42K — official 2026 page
claims: The official page says the marathon has been held since 1984 and calls itself the fastest marathon in Latin America.
The page presents Sunday 20 September 2026, 07:00, at Avenida Figueroa Alcorta and Dorrego as the next edition, and still calls 21 September 2025 the last edition.
The page reports 15,000 entries, 44 countries, a best time of 2:09:04 and 4,923 foreign runners for the 2025 edition.
The page gives Expo Running 42K at Parque Sarmiento, entry by Avenida Triunvirato, on Friday 18 September 12:00–20:00 and Saturday 19 September 10:00–18:00.
The page lists entry at 120 Argentine pesos for residents and US$120 for foreigners; because the page is not updated for 2027, this is not treated as a current price.
The page states that the 42K start and finish are both at Figueroa Alcorta and Dorrego in Palermo and displays a course map whose file is named Recorrido-42K-2024.jpg.
As checked on 20 November 2026, the page had not been updated after the 20 September 2026 race and published no 2027 date or entry information.

verification.note: 官方首页 2026-11-20 复核：仍把 2026-09-20 写成 Próxima edición，Última edición 仍是 2025-09-21；无 2027 日期。报名价 120 比索/120 美元明显是旧页面文本，不进入 2027 判断。
